# Independent compact guide trial

Guide-only trial on Darwin arm64, with the final binary identity in [the record](README.md).
The operator followed the public command guide and CV tuple grammar, used owned
synthetic repository/control files, and independently decoded JSON in Python.

| Task | Actual result |
|---|---|
| Public bundled fixture | Ordinary/compact exited 0 with two matching decoded rows. |
| Full file/Git views | File 80, status 22, diff 20 and history 12 compact rows reconstructed exactly to ordinary reports, including scanner/source/count/order fields. |
| Small report | One-line output fell back to ordinary JSON. |
| Tight caps | Compact returned file 21 versus ordinary 13 rows and status 10 versus 7; prefix order and omissions matched, full selected file scans and Git calls remained. |
| One-byte cap | Exit 2 with zero output, confirming the INC-21 path. |
| Rule findings | Exit 1, ordinary report versions, no source rows or selected source identities. |
| Help | Both help forms advertise compact. |
| Preservation | All 137 owned repository/control files byte-identical before/after. |
| Skill routing | Governed-tool adoption routes here; ordinary Git/prose work does not. Manual assessment only. |

The initially supplied pre-freeze binary differed from a current source build. Those
receipts were retained; the final trial reran with the exact published qualification
pin. No source files, real repo config, hooks, global settings, credentials or providers
were modified or used. This qualifies the toy task, not installation or production cost.
